nom: Erborian Centella Cleansing Gel with Centella Asiatica & Squalane

avis.texte: IYKYK this smells like walking into Hollister from back in the day and it's so strong and stays on the skin. I definitely wouldn't repurchase or recommend.

I'm using this gel cleanser in my 2 step cleansing routine. It has a nice consistency. It feels good on the skin. Rinses off well. Leaves my skin feeling fresh and not overly dry. However, I not like the scent. It is rather strong (and unnecessary). It does not last/linger once rinsed off.
I use this after the cleansing balm to double cleanser. Excellent product!

I have been suffering from skin outbreaks at 61 years old and red discolouration on my checks for several months, My normal creams, cleansers and make up seem to irritate my skin, I was recently advised to try Erborian, which I've been using for about one month and can already see improvements, so pleased with their products.
Have been using it alongside the cleansing oil and it makes my skin feel really clean without feeling tight, and I have had fewer breakouts.
I love this lathered up well and after my double cleanse of the oil aswell my skin feels soft and clean with other brands it was left tight and dry love love
This product is great, I use this after the cleansing balm just to ensure a thorough cleanse. It's so gentle but effective. Feels like a spa treatment
I love this product. It smells amazing, is really mild for my sensitive skin but very effective.
Really enjoy this cleanser. It's not drying and great for sensitive skin. Also really enjoy the scent of it.

avis.titre: I will be buying this again.
avis.texte: I love the foaming and the smell. It also takes off mascara with very little rubbing.

It melts away my makeup and doesn't leave my skin tight the way other facial cleansers have. Would like a better way to distribute the product to give more control as sometimes I can use too much. That's the only reason it got 4 stars.
Obsessed, only need small amounts, my skin is so smooth and soft after use :grinning_face_with_star_eyes:
Amazing, this is. My favorite cleansing gel from first time use.

I have been using this as my second cleanse (after the cleansing oil with a warm face cloth) for about a month or so now and I think it is making a positive difference to my skin. My skin is brighter and more youthful looking. The scent is divine and I just feel properly cleansed and fresh after using this. I would recommend.

Works beautifully, and with a lovely cucumbery smell. slightly jelly ish but fluid. Doesn't sting or make my skin go red like Micellar water. Doesn't completely remove eye make up, but it's probably not for that.
Love this cleanser! Makes face feel so clean without being too harsh on my skin! Tried many cleansers in the past and have to say this one is a stand out!
Bit too foamy for my liking, as I prefer a more creamy cleanser
I love this cleansing gel as it's gentle on the skin and does not strip my skin
Must have cleanser for all skin types! Bought for me but also used by teenagers with blemishes. Everyone LOVES it
Recommend for those who need a cleanser that's not too harsh but also it cleans deeply
I am so converted with this face cleansing gel. I love the fresh smell and a little really goes a long way!
Works well and smells good. Slightly too much comes out of the pump so doesn't feel like it lasts a long time
Love this one too, takes off everything including mascara, doesn't sting my eyes
Lovely light weight cleansing gel that leaves your skin feeling clean and fresh.
Really like this product, great smell, really clean feeling. I was hoping it would do a little more for my redness but it's better than other products.
I've only been using for a few weeks but so far very impressed.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Bought this size as love the full size but easier for travelling Works really well and goes a long way

Just bought the gel cleanser to try as I use and love the BB cream. I loved the pump dispenser which makes it easy to control the amount used and it just glided over my skin removing any makeup. It has a wonderful subtle smell and left my skin feeling soft and smooth.

I have been double cleansing for a while , this removes oil based cleanser very easily and leaves the skin very clean but not tight . Personally I felt that it was a little to good at removing oil on a more mature skin but would be fantastic on not such dry skin. Caused no irritation.
I really love this cleansing !! My skin feel s really clean and fresh :) and the smell is just amazing 😊
I love Erborian products snd decided to have a go on this one, I have very dry skin and sadly this product makes my skin even drier. It might be good for other skin types but not for mine.
This is great. I initially buy small sizes to test them out. I will definitely be going large with this in the near future.
I have mature skin suffering from rosacea. Thus gel is very gentle but thorough and with some of the other Eborian products for rosacea I'm seeing much better skin tone and softness again.

I use this with the cleansing oil and they have completely cleared my skin, smoothed it, softened it, the sensitivity has really reduced and reactivity. I'm a convert and will be buying more. I love this cleanser
Really loved this cleanser. It smelt gorgeous, it lathered really soft and smooth giving it a luxurious feel. My skin definitely was softer after using.
Leaves my skin feeling clean and resfreshed. I don't care for the scent, but the product works well!
Lovely foaming gel, used after the oil and my skin has never felt cleaner Smells amazing, like a super posh hotel Used with the oil and my night time routine has been transformed

avis.titre: It's a Little Drying Over Time
avis.texte: I tried this cleanser in their sampler. The cleanser is okay. I've been using it because I thought it would help with my breakouts, but it's just been drying my skin out. I've developed dry patches where the breakouts are. Even on areas I don't have them as well. I have combonation skin. Someone with oliy skin may enjoy this facial cleanser. But this product is a pass for me.
I love the cleansing gel and oil for my nightly face cleansing routine!
Really good at removing last traces of makeup after using the Centella Cleansing oil. Skin left feeling soft and hydrated.
Super gentle cleanser. Skin doesn't feel tight after cleansing. In the smaller bottle the product does come out quick so be careful. Will be buying full sized bottle with a pump asap!

It smells amazing and I really enjoy the texture of the face wash. It leaves my skin lovely and soft and I will definitely be trying the other product for a dual face wash. Also, I think most importantly, a little goes a long way!
I had expected this cleanser to be very gentle however I found the smell very strong and felt it was quite harsh on my delicate mature skin.
My skin after using this cleansing becoming more smoother and gently.
This cleanser is really refreshing and was a pleasant supprise as I didn't know what to expect x
Love this! smells great, gets all the makeup off and leaves skin soft and not over dry.

I got this as a sample and omg i have to buy !!! Literally one of the best cleansers ive come across besides cera ve foaming wash. This smells very unique and so good! Thank god for free gifts with purchases :p
Purchased the travel size to try out but will be purchasing the larger size. Really lovely cleanser. I love the scent. Smells & feels very fresh. Gentle on skin & love how my skin feels after using.

My first time buying an expensive product and happily Erborian so far did not disappoint me. I like the gel texture, and the smell is so nice and clean. It cleans the face and afterward, it feels so clean and smooth, with no tightness at all. When I checked myself in the mirror I saw an immediate effect, after the first use, my skin was so luminous, it was like I saw myself in HD and my skin was so neat, firm, and luminous, I was impressed.
My skin feels so clean after using this and it leaves a really nice texture on my skin
My skin feels so clean after using this and it leaves a really nice texture on my skin

I have combination skin, and after reading mostly positive reviews about this product I thought I'd give it a try. I wasn't impressed, the gel really dried my skin out and not too keen on the scent either.

avis.titre: Great cleanser with a beautiful smell!
avis.texte: I bought this product in the smaller size during Black Friday sales. My skin is combination and has some redness so finding the right cleanser has been a struggle. I've just the same cleanser for a year now and didn't think I'd find something that would match it. This cleanser surpassed that and then some! My skin feels thoroughly cleansed without feeling stripped or dry and the smell is divine and last ages. I love it so much I've already bought the larger bottle. Strongly recommend this product.

My skin feels thoroughly cleansed without feeling stripped or dry and the smell is divine and last ages. I love it so much I've already bought the larger bottle. Strongly recommend this product.
Leaves skin smooth and not feeling tight at all, smells lovely and a little bit goes a long way!
Leaves skin smooth and not feeling tight at all, smells lovely and a little bit goes a long way!

Certainly this product removes every trace of makeup & daily grime, it's creamy in texture but I'm not sure how effective it is. Since adopting this range my skin has been pretty awful, multiple breakouts, dullness & therefore I feel it may be pretty â€˜potent'. I'm going back to Vichy! (Very expensive mistake)

Since adopting this range my skin has been pretty awful, multiple breakouts, dullness & therefore I feel it may be pretty 'potent'. I'm going back to Vichy! (Very expensive mistake)
A really effective but gentle cleanser. Removes eye makeup easily and leaves skin feels soft and clean
Amazing cleanser, melts away all the makeup leaves your skin clean and very clear with just one wash.

I have struggled through Alot of products to find something that was kind to my skin but also a good cleanser, this stuff is my go to product now, my skin feels clean and fresh, but light I don't feel like my skin is tight and and dry, I follow this with a few more of their products, absolutely amazing skin care range I have combination skin, and get really oily break outs, since using erborian I have no excess oils, my skin has improved within a week and its the only brand that has got rid of my stubborn black heads. I can't say anything about any of the products I have used except your skin will thank you.
After purchasing the BB cream I ordered the CC cream in the same shade to take on holiday for everyday coverage with factor 25 !!
I've been using a couple of weeks and was expecting it to be more moisturising but its not; around eyes still feels a tad dry. I will persevere, but not sure I'd buy again.

Wow what a lovely cleansing gel this is! The smell is so fresh & pretty & it makes light work of removing all traces of dirt & pollution, leaving my skin feeling perfectly clean without any tightness. Also makes the perfect double cleansing routine when used alongside the Centella Cleansing Oil to remove make-up. My go to cleansing range & I love it!
Used after the equally awesome oil cleanser, great for sensitive dry and eczema prone skin. You don't need much so the bottle lasts.

Wow what a lovely cleansing gel this is! The smell is so fresh & pretty & it makes light work of removing all traces of dirt & pollution, leaving my skin feeling perfectly clean without any tightness. Also makes the perfect double cleansing routine when used alongside the Centella Cleansing Oil to remove make-up. My go to cleansing range & I love it!
This cleanser leaves my face feeling fresh and clean, it's smells lovely and is perfect to use everyday!

I have tried a variety of products but Erborian keeps surprising me. I have noticed that my exposure to the sun, as well as my diet sometimes cause uneven skin surface and blemishes. This little bottle did its magic as I can already feel my skin is smoother and I have a sort of a glow after every application. I use it daily and couldn't recommend it more if you have similar problems to mine. Also, light texture for better application and does not feel heavy during summer. Just love it!
